name: Strata
what: A Python-fronted inference server with its own engine binary, built for long context on consumer cards: a model loads on request or at start, unloads through its API, and keeps a configuration file per served model.

can: start a unit from its launcher
load and unload through the API
park a unit that would load on any request
run a launch-namespace preset as a unit of its own (strata launch --preset)
cannot: change a unit's context without editing its configuration file

update.note: Updates the Python side of a checkout (git pull --ff-only, pip install -e .). The engine binary under engine/ is a separate build or download: when the check says the engine changed, rebuild or refetch it by hand. A custom build should override this with git-check.

all: python -m venv .venv && .venv/Scripts/pip install -e . (Scripts/ is bin/ on Linux)
Follow upstream for the engine binary that matches your card.
Write a strata-<name>.json per model (upstream's examples), and a run-<name>.bat that calls serve/server.py with it.

good: one large model resident at very long context
models the engine has a route for, at quants the card can hold
not: many small models coming and going: Ollama does that
a model the engine has no route for: llama.cpp will
